vedic_reference.note: Bhuvana is a name of Goddess Bhuvaneshwari, who is the Goddess of the universe and the patron goddess of the earth. She is also considered the mother of the earth and is revered for her nurturing and protective qualities. In Vedic scriptures, she is mentioned as the source of all beings and the sustainer of the universe.
